{{Infobox auto}}

'''Dough''' is an [[ingredient]] made from [[flour]] and the base of breads, pastries and pasta. It can't be eaten. Baked in an [[oven]] or on [[kindling]] it becomes [[bread]], and fired in a [[mud kiln]] it becomes [[naan]].

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
An [[egg]] and 2 flour make 4 dough. A [[Glass Bottle|water bottle]] and 1 flour make 1 dough and give the glass bottle back.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/dough.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/dough_from_water.json}}</ref> The water recipe accepts any potion.

== Usage ==

Picking up dough unlocks [[bread]], [[naan]], [[seitan]] and slime balls (dough and lime dye make 2). Dough is the base of the empanadas, [[Pizza|pizzas]], [[stroganoff]], cupcakes, [[brownie]]s, [[chocolate chip cookie]]s, [[Buñuelo|buñuelos]], [[puerquito]]s, [[pupusa]]s, [[lumpia]], [[Pad Thai]], [[chorus mochi]], [[ramen stock]] and more.
